searchText: Do any of the clients try to appeal more to commercial users like exchanges or dapps? Or does each try to appeal to all users equally. I believe Besu and Nethermind both target enterprise customers. Any idea what they do different to appeal to enterprise customers? Aka what is needed at scale for instance lots of txs a second? My guess is white glove service and support contracts. Interesting. Good to see that some of the teams aren't just funded by donations. Nethermind has a plug-in system which makes it easy to extend for individual customer needs. Definitely something I'm googling As does besu.
